methods.label: Conjugate product and modulus
methods.explanation: The product of \(z\) and its conjugate equals the square of its modulus, which is \(2\) here.
methods.levelReason: The conjugate-product identity and complex modulus are within the same required-course scope.

methods.label: Difference of squares
methods.explanation:
The factors have the same real term and opposite imaginary terms, so the difference-of-squares formula applies. Since \(i^2=-1\),
\[
(1+i)(1-i)=1-i^2=2.
\]
methods.levelReason: Uses an earlier algebraic identity together with i squared equals negative one, requiring no modulus formula.
